text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —"Feng shui." It is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"It is well-founded 'Environmental Fortune 
Science.' It is by no means mere 
occultism."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It is an orthodox discipline that has been 
accumulated and refined over the course of 
three thousand long years.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"If you read the earth's fortunes with 
feng shui and channel its energy properly, 
then yes, anyone can—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's so easy to find happiness☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See, isn't it amazing!? So why not start 
practicing feng shui with me? Huh? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Your grades in races and tests are bound 
to shoot right up, no doubt about it♪

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if that's really true, I think that's 
pretty amazing, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Still, wouldn't just saying a prayer at 
the shrine be enough? See ya later, 
Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come on~. I'm telling you, it's not 
the same thing as praying to the gods!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, nobody gets it as usual. All I want 
is to make everyone happy, though~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, now that it's come to this, 
there's only one thing to do! There's only 
one thing I can do, yep☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! Don't you think the time is 
ripe?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I found a partner in you, and together 
we've wrapped up our basic training. And 
then, on the way to school this morning—"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
As I was running up the slope from west to 
east, the morning sun looked brighter than 
usual. That was...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In "Landform Feng Shui," which judges by 
what is visible, this is a clear omen. In 
other words—it's a sign to charge forward!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, don't you think it's time to give 
it a shot? The Twinkle Series! Now is our 
time to shine☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Of course! A mutually generative 
encounter... Ever since that day I joined 
hands with Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I've been preparing for this all along! 
Yes, aiming for this very moment♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—To show everyone the power of feng shui 
and spread its word, Copano Rickey sets 
her sights on the Twinkle Series."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first glance, it might look suspicious. 
But as her Trainer, I know better.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look there! In that corner! The 
Trainers are starting to focus way more 
than usual. The reason being...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, running like this might be 
dangerous! We should stop them before the 
start!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through feng shui, Copano Rickey sensed 
the danger. And just as she had feared, it 
really happened. Furthermore...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I see it...! I can feel it...! The flow 
of Qi. The voice of the earth... is 
telling me how the field is shifting.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(The final stretch! 'Form', 'Energy'... 
Everything is aligned. The fortune is 
perfect. All that's left is—)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The fastest one wins!! All our built-up 
power, directed full force into the 
auspicious direction!! 
Yaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Using the power of feng shui, she read 
the race development perfectly and 
delivered a magnificent performance."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's Feng Shui is by no means a 
gimmick. And—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to win! I want to make a huge 
splash in the Twinkle Series and make 
everyone believe in the power of feng 
shui—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I want to make everyone happy☆ Just like 
feng shui did for me!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Something that grants you a flicker of 
courage when encountering trouble or 
starting a new life. Yes...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"That's feng shui☆ As long as you know how 
to arrange your space and seize the 
opportunity, anyone can find happiness!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her motive was pure and direct. By 
spreading feng shui through her running, 
she could make everyone happy. That's why 
she wants to run."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More than enough reason to support her. 
She was an Umamusume I wanted to see stand 
at the pinnacle at all costs.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer? Will you give me the green 
light?
choice_data_list:
Of course! Let's give it our all starting 
today!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Now we just have to change how 
everyone sees us, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
In a real race, I'll show everyone just 
how amazing the power of feng shui is☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Umm, Rickey. Have you decided? About 
making your debut.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Then congratulations. Also, about what we 
briefly talked about earlier...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You're coming to the dirt division? I 
heard people saying it might suit you 
better than turf.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oho oho, if Ricky-chan is coming along 
too, then things are gonna be a whole lot 
of fun from here on~

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tarumae, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course I plan to do my best on 
dirt☆ To start with, anyway. Because...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Dirt is super well-suited for feng shui♪ 
Because the scattering sand takes shape to 
convey the state of the area and 
everyone's will."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Feng shui... Ricky, you're always 
talking about such pipe dreams.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is Hokko Tarumae. One year 
older than Copano Rickey, she's a local 
idol who runs with all her heart for her 
hometown of Tomakomai.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, but having a dream is a wonderful 
thing, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This Umamusume is 'Wonder Acute.' A 
seasoned dirt-track veteran who talks just 
like an elderly grandma.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm all for giving it your all, but it's 
probably best not to get too caught up in 
superstitions...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's all just run together at a 
nice, relaxed pace~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan is basically like a 
granddaughter to me, so I've got to give 
her lots and lots of pats on the head~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you two~. In my own way, I'm 
totally serious about racing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, they probably won't believe in Feng 
Shui power until they see it in an actual 
race, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it might not sound very 
convincing. In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's prove it in the race, Ricky!
Let's prove it in the race, Ricky!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right! Just like how you 
believed in me, Trainer, I'm sure everyone 
else will believe in me someday too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! I'll spread feng 
shui through my running and make everyone 
absolutely happy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Rickeyâ Luckyâ Super Happy!!
